comment: Hosts the skin build needs in the Tauri CSP on top of the base CSP (tauri.conf.json is not edited; scripts/skin-csp.mjs merges this file into a TAURI_CONFIG override). Every host is contacted only by the bundled BitcornWisdom chart (bitcorn/src/*.js) with read-only public market-data requests.

connect-src.reason: Kraken OHLC REST history for the *-USD-SPOT charts
Kraken WebSocket v2 ohlc channel (live candles, primary USD spot venue)
Coinbase Exchange candles REST history (USD spot failover venue)
Coinbase Exchange WebSocket matches/heartbeat feed (USD spot failover venue)
Binance Spot klines REST for the LTC/BTC-USDT spot instruments (market-data-only host)
Binance Spot klines REST, second host tried by BitcornWisdom after data-api.binance.vision
Binance USD-M futures klines REST for the BTC/LTC-USDT perpetuals (futures contracts)
Binance USD-M futures kline WebSocket stream

replace.reason: the chart is a same-origin iframe (/bitcorn/embed.html) inside the app window; 'none' would stop the webview from framing its own document
replace.verified: with the unchanged policy the webview logs "Framing 'http://tauri.localhost/' violates ... frame-ancestors 'none'" and the chart never completes its handshake (check-fe-speed-skin.mjs, 2026-11-05)
